name: baby-blue-slime-no-class-bonus-with-non-tamer-champion
notes: Baby Blue Slime (9ggfiy38t2, WATER ALLY, TAMER/ANIMAL/SLIME, reserve 2, POWER 1 / LIFE 2): "[Class Bonus] CARDNAME gets +1 LIFE. [REST]: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to another target Slime ally you control this turn." Baby Blue Slime is played for real from hand (FSM play + 2 reserve payments); WATER is unlocked by patching a Nico lineage into the champion and the deck is colorless so no fast-spell windows interrupt the flow. Negative path: the champion is Spirit of Fire (class SPIRIT, not TAMER), so [Class Bonus] does not apply and Baby Blue Slime keeps its printed LIFE of 2. Proved functionally too: the same 2-power attack (Dungeon Guide with 1 buff counter) now destroys it.
